description: Sisteme de alimentare cu apa si de canalizare is a dataset listed in Government Open Data Portal Moldova, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by statbank.statistica.md. Data on water supply systems in territorial aspect; Sewerage systems in territorial aspect; Sewerage systems equipped with wastewater treatment plants in territorial aspect; Volume of water distributed to consumers in territorial aspect. Coverage: MD. The portal shows the English title as "Water supply and sewerage systems" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include aprovizionare cu apă, canalizare. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is License Not Specified. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-government-open-data-portal-moldova.
